component.name: Stalker GAMMA
component.summary: Install and update Stalker Anomaly and the GAMMA mod pack

description.p: The stalker-gamma CLI installs and updates Stalker Anomaly and the G.A.M.M.A. mod pack from the command line.

ul.li: Install and update Stalker Anomaly and GAMMA
Offline installs from a cache archive
Multiple install profiles, e.g. stable and testing
Manage Mod Organizer 2 profiles and mods
Machine-readable JSON output for GUI wrappers
